description: The all-time record between two players, across BOTH halves of the product. That is the results archive (1968 to 2022) plus the completed matches from 2023 onward. Names are the keys. An ambiguous fragment returns the candidate list to choose from, and nothing is guessed. Totals count only meetings with a known winner. Walkovers and retirements are part of the record, and each meeting carries its outcome. Requires the BASIC plan or any History plan.

player1.description: First player name (fragment, min 3 chars), e.g. "federer".

player2.description: Second player name (fragment, min 3 chars), e.g. "nadal".

name: get_h2h

by_surface.description: Decided wins per surface. The keys are surface names plus "unknown".

meetings.description: Individual meetings, newest first, capped at 200.

date.description: Match date (current era) or tournament start date (archive era).

match_id.description: Our match id (current era rows). Pass to get_match.

outcome.description: completed, retired, walkover, ... Exclude non-completed yourself if needed.

score.description: Final score (archive rows only. Read current rows from get_match).

winner.description: 1 or 2 OF THE REQUEST (player1/player2 as you passed them), not of the underlying match row.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

players.description: The resolved names. Null when no player matches the fragments.

undecided.description: Meetings with no derivable winner. Never counted in wins.

title: Head-to-head
